folder_path.description: The folder path to save data models and reports.

password.description: The Oracle Business Intelligence user password.

server_url.description: The Oracle Business Intelligence Instance URL.

schema_prefix.title: Destination schema prefix
schema_prefix.description: Destination schema prefix. Prefix for each replicated schema. For example with prefix 'x', source schemas 'foo' and 'bar' get replicated as 'x_foo' and 'x_bar'. The prefix is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation

password.description: ESM key for the Oracle Business Intelligence user password.

username.description: ESM key for the Oracle Business Intelligence username.

external_secrets_keys_config.description: A JSON object mapping configuration field names to their corresponding secret key names in your external secrets manager. Requires `external_secrets_manager_id` to be set.
